facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a long 1960s ranch with a stone-veneer wainscot under the shuttered windows, a picture window, a centre chimney, a breezeway carport at one end with a car in it; a wide open new lawn on a curbed street, a sapling
